name: Remote Receiver → On Keeloq
description: An automation to perform when a KeeLoq RF code has been decoded. A variable `x` of type <APIStruct text="remote_base::KeeloqData" path="remote_base::KeeloqData" /> is passed to the automation for use in lambdas. Up to 16 bits that follow the 66-bit HCS301 word are in `x.suffix`, lowest bit first, and their number is in `x.suffix_bits`. Both are `0` when these bits do not end at a gap or at the end of the capture, or when there are more than 16; the 66-bit word is still reported. For a 72-bit Jarolift TDEF frame, where `x.suffix_bits` is `6`, `x.group()` returns its 8 group bits. Check `x.suffix_bits` first: for other frames `x.group()` is not a group. The log shows such a frame with `group=`.
